newsitem.title: USA: Seitel sees Grady Ranch production soon.
newsitem.headline: Seitel sees Grady Ranch production soon.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Wednesday commercial production is expected to begin next week from the Gracey Ranch project in Colorado County, Texas, about 60 miles west/southwest of Houston.

The company said a three-dimensional (3D) seismic-assisted development project there had successful completed five out of five natural gas wells drilled and identified up to 12 additional exploratory and development locations.
Seitel said its petroleum exploration and production subsidiary, DDD Energy Inc, has a 25 percent working interest in the project, providing 3D seismic technology and related geophysical expertise.

It is anticipated the five wells will have combined daily production of some 15 million cubic feet of natural gas and 225 barrels of oil per day, when stabilized flow capacity is reached, Seitel said, adding this is expected by early November.

During the first 12 months of full production, it is estimated that revenue to DDD Energy, which has an 18.25 percent net revenue interest in each of the wells, will be in excess of $2.5 million (based on current wellhead pricing).
The other working-interest partners are three privately-held companies.
